entities.label: kpi
entities.description: Key performance indicator expressible in numerical and monetary value, such as revenue or net sales.

entities.label: cy
entities.description: Current year monetary value of a KPI.

entities.label: py
entities.description: Prior year monetary value of a KPI.

entities.label: py1
entities.description: Monetary value of a KPI two years before the current year.

entities.label: increase
entities.description: Increase of a KPI from the previous year to the current year.

entities.label: increase_py
entities.description: Analogous to increase, but from two years back to the prior year.

entities.label: decrease
entities.description: Decrease of a KPI from the previous year to the current year.

entities.label: decrease_py
entities.description: Analogous to decrease, but from two years back to the prior year.

entities.label: thereof
entities.description: A subordinate KPI: a KPI that is part of another, broader KPI.

entities.label: attr
entities.description: Attribute that further describes a KPI.

entities.label: kpi_coref
entities.description: A co-reference to a KPI mentioned in a previous sentence.

relations.label: RELATED_VALUE
relations.description: Links a KPI to a value or change that belongs to it. The link has no direction.
